name: Kidou Houshinki
source:
Once upon a time.... A legendary country "Yama Taikoku" ruled by Himiko. The presence of this country is still remained in mystery and many historians argue about it. An archaeologist, Shuichiro, starts to show his extraordinary talent triggered by a certain incident. The basis of this power is called Kidou and this ability is only used by the descendants of Himiko. However, four women appear in front of Shuichiro. The battle between Shuichiro and four women breaks out....!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081030014039/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003368]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
从前……由卑弥呼统治的传说中的国家“山太国”。这个国家的存在仍然是个谜，许多历史学家对此争论不休。考古学家修一郎因某件事件而开始展现出非凡的才华。这种力量的基础被称为鬼童，这种能力只有卑弥呼的后裔才能使用。然而，四个女人出现在修一郎的面前。修一郎与四个女人的战斗爆发了……！
